basics.name: Petr Hýl
basics.label: Frontend Developer with an AI Workflow
basics.summary: Frontend developer who has been building and deploying websites, e-shops and PWAs for the web agency IMPnet as a freelancer since 2022 – around 150 projects so far. I develop with AI agents in Claude Code: I write custom skills, build multi-agent workflows and maintain a knowledge base the agents work from. A background in PR and customer support means I am comfortable working with clients in Czech, English and French.

work.name: IMPnet, s.r.o. (web agency)
work.summary: Turning designs into templates, deploying websites and e-shops, maintaining and extending client projects.
highlights: Around 150 websites, e-shops and real-estate portals, from a Figma / Adobe XD design to launch on the production server.
PWAs: hand-written service worker, manifest and offline mode (app.lindabstrechy.cz, thermo-control.cz, mentem.cz).
mentem.cz – user profile for a games portal with player statistics, Chart.js charts and family licences (about 240 hours of development).
Performance: raised the mobile PageSpeed score of amrs.cz from 33 to 85.
E-mail and PDF document templates (product sheets, orders, property cards).
GitLab workflow – issues, merge requests, deploys; launching sites including DNS and SSL.
